ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white/light-gray background with irregular low-intensity (black) mottling and discrete circular spots. Left lobe exhibits a solid dark region at the peduncle base transitioning to discrete spots towards the distal edge. other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of small, high-density dark spots specifically concentrated near the apex of the right lobe's trailing edge.
